provenance.basis: Headword labels and articles in the two official pupil lists; teacher lists checked separately.

normalization.senseRule: Retain sourceLabels. Equal spelling does not establish equal grammatical sense; sein(-) in BW3 is not evidence about the BW1 verb sein.

limitations: Membership is not a definition, a difficulty calibration, or a KOMPASS test prediction.
Optional endings are recorded as source patterns; the export does not enumerate all inflections.
Source-case distinctions such as arm/Arm and paar/Paar must remain distinct at runtime.
The official description of approximately 870 words uses a different counting basis from this normalized headword export.
